INDEPENDENT CONSULTING SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Agreement is made between Bright Path Consulting LLC ("Consultant")
and Northgate Manufacturing Inc. ("Client").

1. Services
The Consultant will provide supply-chain optimization advisory services as
described in Schedule A, on a best-efforts basis. No specific financial
outcome is guaranteed, as results depend on factors outside the Consultant's
control.

2. Fees and Payment
The Client will pay a fixed monthly retainer of $4,000, invoiced at the end
of each calendar month, payable by bank transfer within 30 days of the
invoice date.

3. Term and Termination
This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues on a month-to-month
basis. Either party may terminate this Agreement with 30 days' written notice
to the other party.

4. Confidentiality
Both parties agree to keep confidential any proprietary information shared
during the engagement and not to disclose it to third parties without prior
written consent.

5. Liability
Each party's liability under this Agreement is limited to the fees paid in
the preceding three months, except in cases of gross negligence or willful
misconduct.

6. Data Protection
Any personal data processed under this Agreement will be handled in
accordance with applicable data protection law. The Client may withdraw any
data-processing consent at any time by written notice.

7. Governing Law
This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York. Any disputes
shall be resolved in the courts located in New York County.

8. Amendments
This Agreement may only be amended in writing, signed by both parties.

Signed:
_____________________            _____________________
Bright Path Consulting LLC        Northgate Manufacturing Inc.
